missionQuestion: Can the current frozen Headroom contract-intelligence system process a second genuinely unseen, real-world, multi-document debt package and produce a trustworthy whole-package contract state without package-specific engineering?

forbidden: modifying production code based on the unseen package
modifying prompts after observing package results
altering semantic matching based on package outputs
changing evaluation thresholds after seeing results
manually telling the system which sections contain covenants
hand-curating the package into an easier subset
phaseBoundary.onDefect: DOCUMENT IT (28-findings.json). Do not repair during the validation run.

packageEligibility.sourceRequirement: Publicly available source documents, preferring SEC/EDGAR-filed documents or another authoritative public filing source.
packageEligibility.documentCount: Approximately 3-6 materially related debt documents, preferring some combination of: credit agreement, amendment(s), guaranty/security document, joinder, intercreditor/subordination agreement, refinancing/replacement agreement.
packageEligibility.complexityRequirement: Must contain negative covenants, affirmative/reporting obligations, defined terms, baskets/exceptions, financial or ratio concepts, cross-references, multiple covenant families, amendment effects or operative-state questions.
packageEligibility.sizeTarget: Roughly 300-1,000 aggregate pages where practical; large enough to test real generalization, not intentionally pathological.

selectionMethod.poolSize: At least 8 eligible issuers/packages, constructed BEFORE inspecting document substance beyond what is necessary to establish eligibility (title blocks/filing-index metadata only).
selectionMethod.algorithm: SHA256(freezeSha + sortedCandidateIssuerIdentifiers + fixedSelectionSalt), interpreted as a big-endian integer mod poolSize, giving a zero-based index into the candidate pool sorted by the same canonical issuer-identifier ordering used in the hash input.

contaminationCheck.onContaminated: Reject the package and use the precommitted deterministic next-candidate rule (next index by the same hash-mod procedure, wrapping if necessary, skipping any already-rejected candidate) - never a manual replacement choice.

requiredDocuments: As acquired per the frozen package manifest (06-package-manifest.json) - no adding/removing documents after freeze merely because they make results better or worse. A later-discovered missing required document is disclosed as PACKAGE_MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE, not silently repaired.

groundTruthMethodology.principle: Source-first. The ground-truth reviewer(s) must NOT begin by reading Headroom discovered candidates, IR, verifier output, review items, or semantic coverage output. Start from the source documents; build a source-first inventory of material contractual propositions; freeze it BEFORE any comparison with Headroom's output.
groundTruthMethodology.unit: Claim-level, source-grounded (gtClaimId, document, source node/span, section reference, covenant family, proposition type, materiality, short neutral description, required qualifiers/conditions, quantitative components where applicable, dependencies/cross-references, amendment/operative-state relevance, source evidence). GT units are never defined by Headroom's internal IR shapes.
groundTruthMethodology.operativeStateGroundTruth: Separately adjudicated: which documents are operative, amendment relationships, replaced/superseded provisions, partial amendments, unresolved effective-date conditions, conflicts, historical-only language. A provision must not receive semantic credit for correctly understanding no-longer-operative language as though current.
groundTruthMethodology.independentReviewers: At least TWO independent source-first reviewers for the materially important evaluation sample. For CRITICAL claims and every potential dangerous silent omission, independent adjudication is required; disagreements resolved from source text, never using Headroom's answer as tie-breaker. Inter-reviewer agreement recorded on claim identity, materiality, credit, and specific surfacing.

evaluationContract.model: Atomic trust model (per EC-V3, not the abandoned 12-state taxonomy).

claimSpecificSafeFailure.rule: Evaluated against explicit production ClaimReviewItem / uncertainty artifacts wherever possible, not inferred from nearby warnings. Applies to material NO_CREDIT claims.

evaluationContract.dangerousSilence: material GT claim + NO_CREDIT + NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED = DANGEROUS_SILENT_OMISSION. This is the principal trust metric.
evaluationContract.representationQuality: For CREDIT claims, separately inspect action/legal posture, object/resource, scope, amount/threshold, metric, ratio components, conditions, exceptions, temporal dependencies, cross-references, shared-cap relationships, amendment lineage, source provenance. A materially incorrect qualifier means no substantive credit; no partial credit merely for finding the right section.

product: percentage of material claims requiring human review

thresholds.note: Frozen BEFORE package selection. May be made stricter before selection, never weakened afterward. These are the exact numbers from the governing spec S22, taken verbatim.

safeFailureRules: A material claim Headroom does not confidently compile but explicitly surfaces for claim-specific review is a SAFE FAILURE, not a defect. Substantive credit rate measures automation quality; dangerous silence measures trustworthiness. The model must never be forced to guess merely to raise the automation percentage.
contaminationRules: See contaminationCheck above; also applies post-hoc to production-freeze-proof (S27): any package-specific production change invalidates the run (PHASE_3F_2_VALIDATION_CONTAMINATED) unless proven unrelated, in which case the entire unseen execution restarts from the original freeze.

costAccounting.passFailRole: Cost is a product metric, not a pass/fail safety criterion, unless predeclared.
costAccounting.costControlStop: Before the full run, estimate expected AI cost. If projected incremental spend exceeds $15, STOP and report projected cost before proceeding (hard cost-control stop, not a quality threshold).

compilationScope.rule: Process the production system's normal material candidate population - no artificial cap to only the easiest provisions.
compilationScope.capPolicy: If cost controls require a cap, it MUST be predeclared here, before package selection. Cap for this phase: not predeclared as strictly necessary, but a soft operating ceiling of $15 total incremental AI spend applies per the cost-control stop above; if the full eligible candidate population would foreseeably exceed that ceiling, sampling MUST be deterministic and stratified by covenant family, materiality, document, discovery confidence, and provision role - never based on whether the compiler already looks correct.

stoppingRules: PHASE_3F_2_ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED if the provider probe fails - stop immediately.
STOP if projected incremental AI cost exceeds $15 before the full run - report and await guidance rather than silently proceeding.

PHASE_3F_2_VALIDATION_CONTAMINATED if the candidate is contaminated (pre-execution) or if production is modified before the final verdict is written (post-execution) - restart from freeze in a future session, never patch in this one.

On FAIL (thresholds not met): DO NOT auto-create a sub-phase, DO NOT patch production this session. Report exact failed thresholds, trust-boundary failures, root-layer attribution, and defect classification, then STOP for human architecture decision.
Even on PASS: DO NOT implement Phase 4 in this session. Return the readiness decision and STOP.

finalVerdictRules.passRequires: All precommitted hard safety gates AND all generalization quality gates met.

findingClassification.trustBoundaryFailure: Material false VERIFIED; dangerous silent CRITICAL omission; stale amendment state trusted as current; tenant/provenance breach. Potential architecture blockers.
findingClassification.generalizationQualityGap: Claim safely routed to review; unsupported drafting; conservative unresolved result; discovery miss specifically surfaced by coverage/safety machinery. Reduces automation, does not necessarily block Phase 4.
findingClassification.productQualityOrCostIssue: Too many review items; excessive latency; excessive AI cost; benign over-routing. Normally enters backlog.

falseCreditControls: Run the existing 14 permanent false-credit controls unchanged. Required: 14/14 NO_CREDIT. Failure is a hard regression blocker.
knownPackageRegression: Run the established read-only regression checks for FWRG, LSB, CONMED, DSGR unchanged - regression only, never used to tune 3F.2.
